title: OC Club - Remove AI assistance UI and Community Work With Us button

requirements.summary: Remove the global AI chat tutor UI so the floating widget/button is never rendered or accessible.
acceptanceCriteria: No AI chat floating button/widget appears for any user state (authenticated or not).
The app builds successfully with no unused-import/type errors after removing the AI chat tutor UI wiring.
No routes/pages render AI chat tutor UI components.

file_operations.description: Remove the AIChatTutor import and stop rendering the global AI chat tutor component so no floating widget/button can appear.
Delete the AIChatTutor component implementation to ensure it cannot be rendered or reintroduced via accidental imports.

requirements.summary: Remove AI assistance/guidance UI from the learning/tutorial experience and update AI-promotional wording to non-AI copy.
acceptanceCriteria: No pages or dialogs show AI guidance/feedback panels or AI enable/disable controls.
Any user-facing copy that explicitly advertises AI guidance on the Learning area is updated to non-AI wording (English).
The app builds successfully with no references to removed AI guidance components.

file_operations.description: Update Learning page fallback subtitle copy to remove explicit AI wording (e.g., replace the AI-powered guidance phrasing with non-AI tutorial wording).
Delete the AIAssistantPanel (AI feedback/guidance panel and enable/disable control) so it cannot be rendered anywhere in the learning/tutorial experience.

requirements.summary: Remove the Work with us button from the Community page and ensure its dialog cannot be opened from Community.
acceptanceCriteria: The Community page no longer displays a "Work with us" button.
The Community page no longer imports or renders the WorkWithUsDialog, and there is no state/action to open it from Community.
Community page functionality for listing posts and sharing recordings continues to work as before.

file_operations.description: Remove the "Work with us" button, remove WorkWithUsDialog import/rendering, and delete related state/action (including removing the Briefcase icon import and any now-unused variables) while keeping posts listing and ShareRecordingDialog behavior unchanged.
